description:
The facilitators seen relaying settlements, with their known relayer wallets. Paged: this used to return up to 200 rows unpaged, most of their columns null. Null-valued columns are omitted from each row.

Wraps GET /v0/facilitators.
Access: requires an API key (Authorization: Bearer rh_live_… or x-api-key).

Returns:
- chain: The chain served — this deployment's default when none was named.
- facilitators: Facilitator rows, busiest first. Null-valued fields are omitted.
- next_offset: Offset for the next page, or `null`.
- meta: The chain served and `as_of`. On an EMPTY list it also carries `dataset_last_written_at`, `dataset_row_count` and any `warnings` (e.g. `endpoints_catalog_stale`) — so a zero can be read as a quiet market or a stalled ingest rather than guessed at.

chain.description: CAIP-2 chain id. Defaults to the chain this deployment indexes (`eip155:8453` in production, `eip155:84532` on staging) — the same default every endpoint on this API uses. A chain the index does not carry is refused with 400 listing the supported set, never answered with an empty list.

enriched_only.description: Keep only relayers whose nonce and gas balance have been read. A row without `enriched_at` has nothing populated but its address.

limit.description: Rows to return. Clamped to 200; values outside the range are clamped, not rejected.

offset.description: Rows to skip. Use the returned `next_offset`.

name: list_facilitators
title: Relayers, per chain
